nodes.title: START HERE • NIGHTLY
widgets_values:
NIGHTLY • 0.6 BASELINE • Deferred De-Rope Only

1. Install ComfyUI-MAINodes v1.1.3 or newer and select your H3 model, text encoder and VAEs.
2. In Checkpoint Manager choose the Original branch to repair. No Plan or source render is required.
3. Set a NEW De-Rope profile and the Adapter scene range. Source resolution is preserved.
4. Leave manual ranges blank for automatic repair; use a single scene for a targeted range.
5. Review the budget and final-frame reports. Full recovered latents are saved for later upscaling.
